speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) whether the Ministry will consider specifying a fixed radius around playgrounds where smoking is prohibited; (b) if so, whether the Ministry will consider a radius further than five metres, considering the harmful effects of second-hand tobacco smoke to children; and (c) if not, what are the reasons for not specifying a radius.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: How does the Ministry ensure that the ground enforcement officers and the public are clear on the boundaries where smoking is permissible at such instances, as this could lead to disputes on the ground?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: And by and large, this has largely sufficed.

text: And, in fact, the number related to buffer areas is even smaller.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: So, I think this is really like I said, a more realistic way, in terms of highly urbanised and dense Singapore.
